name: XTU profiles
author: Rigbay contributors
description: Switch Intel XTU power-limit profiles (PL1, PL2, time window) and read CPU temperature and power.

services: XTU3SERVICE (named pipes net.pipe://localhost/ExtremeTuningUtility/Tuning and /Monitoring; writes only PL1, PL2, PL2 enable and the time window, after approval)
reads C:\ProgramData\Intel\Intel Extreme Tuning Utility\Profiles.xml, uisettings.xml and xtu.hotkey.settings
